mutations.scope: Sensitivity of the retained guards, not a mutation-coverage percentage.

limitations: Four public read-only source tasks from one repository; applied fixes, profile delivery and native prompt refinement are unmeasured.
Maintenance-agent complete-answer review is neither independent nor blinded. Partial source-key coverage and omitted unknowns are retained.
Both arms have an unresolved original count/truncation criterion. Their accepted-outcome bounds are not point estimates.
Requested model and effort are pinned; served model/effort, host isolation and subscription billing remain unverified.
The English request heuristic is not a validated difficulty or safety classifier and can miss risky tasks. It is opt-in experimental harness logic.
There are no output-oracle retries or online fallback trials. Rejection leaves the max default in place.
The control is local 0.3.4 with pending native batching; this does not measure the published instruction or release benefit.
Preparation and run time are measured; router bookkeeping is unknown. Complete production routing latency is not established.
Client tool receipt intervals include buffering and transport; outside time is not pure model reasoning.
All planned attempts and reported cache/input/output tokens are charged. Reported reasoning is already part of output tokens.
Observed quantiles from eight attempts per arm, or four per subgroup, are descriptive. Repeated attempts are not independent task samples.
Same-max workflow/reference controls can expose variation but do not isolate provider load, cache or experiment order effects.

plan.fallback_scope: No oracle retry within this campaign. A rejected policy leaves the max default in place; any future online fallback and its cost require separate measurement.
plan.inputs_scope: Same frozen local instruction, source, native binary, task and key as the preceding control; only declared effort selection changes.
plan.promotion_rule: No paired original-request loss or material false conclusion. At least 10% fewer tokens per accepted task or 10% lower total latency p50, with no worse observed total latency p95. Public calibration only; no production promotion without unseen qualification.
